title: 月之暗面Kimi K3模型冲击美国科技股
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: For that, we're joined by Bloomberg executive editor for Global Technology, Peter Elstrom.
segments.zh: 我们请到了彭博全球科技执行主编Peter Elstrom。

segments.en: So Peter, how do you read this moment? Do you think that it's a deep seek version two or do you think it's something different?
segments.zh: Peter，你怎么看？这是DeepSeek第二版还是别的什么？

segments.en: Because now a lot of the tech companies kind of had an idea of what the deep seek could do, but this is moonshot.
segments.zh: 很多科技公司已经了解DeepSeek的能力，但这是Moonshot。

segments.en: Maybe it's something new altogether. Yeah, I think the tech companies in the U.S. in particular thought they knew where the competition was coming from in China, and this was a bit of a surprise.
segments.zh: 可能是个全新事物。美国科技公司以为知道中国竞争来自哪里，这次有点意外。

segments.en: We had seen the deep seek moment last year as you had talked about.
There were some other players that were kind of prominent, including Oli Baba, the e-commerce company that has a strong model in Gwen in particular.
segments.zh: 还有其他突出玩家，比如阿里巴巴，其通义千问模型很强。

segments.en: But then over the weekend we got this news from moonshot that they had introduced Kimi K3, which is a very powerful model, it outstrips most of the frontier models on many parameters,
segments.zh: 周末Moonshot推出Kimi K3，非常强大，在多项参数上超越大多数前沿模型。

segments.en: except for the two leading ones from Anthropic and OpenAI.
segments.zh: 仅落后于Anthropic和OpenAI的两大领先模型。

segments.en: So it's a very strong performer, it has 2.8 trillion parameters, which is sort of like equivalent to brain synapses.
segments.zh: 它拥有2.8万亿参数，相当于大脑突触。

segments.en: It's a very powerful model, and I think that's surprised people that there was yet another Chinese company that was able to come and compete with the best from Silicon Valley on
segments.zh: 这令人惊讶，又一家中国公司能与硅谷顶尖模型竞争。

segments.en: a number of parameters at cost that people really don't understand at this point.
segments.zh: 大量参数的成本，目前人们还不太了解。

segments.en: Many of these Chinese models are also open source or open weight, so they're much less expensive, they're offered very broadly.
segments.zh: 许多中国模型是开源或开放权重的，因此价格更低，应用广泛。

segments.en: If you don't want to run them on somebody else's computer systems, you can run them on your own.
segments.zh: 如果不想用别人的系统，可以自己运行。
